name: Supervision

subjectOf.text: Combined with other corporate governance mechanisms, contingent capital securities function as an internal, institution specific mechanism that could fill the void left by regulators' apparent inability to supervise financial institutions effectively.
subjectOf.abstract: Com- bined with other corporate governance mechanisms, CCSs, as an internal institution-specific mechanism, could help fill a void left by regulators' seeming inability to supervise financial institutions effectively.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Initial Reflections on the Possible Application of Contingent Capital in Corporate Governance (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=1998455
scope_conditions: where CCS are used alongside, not instead of, other corporate governance mechanisms

subjectOf.text: Because of the value to effort focus of work flows in the DAO structure, supervision of management and the imposition of legal duties on management are less needed, since there are fewer or no supervisors, so the fiduciary duties on which the traditional regulatory infrastructure relies become less necessary.
subjectOf.abstract: Because of the value to effort focus of work flows in the DAO structure, supervision of management and imposition of legal duties on management is less needed because there are fewer or no supervisors.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Solutions for Agency Problems in Corporate Governance (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3373393
scope_conditions: DAO structures with few or no supervisors

subjectOf.text: The complex trading, investing and corporate structures of active international hedge funds are a major constraint on effective prudential supervision.
subjectOf.abstract: One of the major constraining factors that constricts effective prudential supervision of hedge funds is the complex trading-, investing- and corporate structure of active international hedge funds.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Indirect Regulation of Hedge Funds (2019). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3405660
scope_conditions: internationally active hedge funds with complex group structures
